# Copilot Instructions

- Scope: Guide AI agents working on the AI Orchestrator (FastAPI + filesystem task queue + hierarchical memory) and the Orchestrator Web Viewer (FastAPI + static frontend).
- Repos/layout: Primary source here; mirrored viewer exists at scripts/modules/orchestrator_web_viewer but edit [orchestrator_web_viewer](orchestrator_web_viewer/README.md) in this repo unless explicitly told otherwise. High-level docs: [README.md](README.md), [docs/CONTAINERIZATION_STRATEGY.md](docs/CONTAINERIZATION_STRATEGY.md), [docs/TASK_QUEUE_DESIGN.md](docs/TASK_QUEUE_DESIGN.md), [memory/README.md](memory/README.md), [docs/ORCHESTRATOR_VIEWER_DESIGN.md](docs/ORCHESTRATOR_VIEWER_DESIGN.md), [docs/WEB_UI_DESIGN.md](docs/WEB_UI_DESIGN.md).
- Architecture: PostgreSQL + pgvector container; orchestrator container (FastAPI in [docker/orchestrator/main.py](docker/orchestrator/main.py#L1) etc.) bind-mounts [task_queue](task_queue/) + [logs](logs/); host-only pieces include kmtui, CLI workers (claude/codex/gemini) and llama.cpp on RTX 5090. Containers reach host via host.docker.internal.
- Task queue rules (see [docs/TASK_QUEUE_DESIGN.md](docs/TASK_QUEUE_DESIGN.md)): states are queued/ → assigned/ → in_progress/ → completed/|failed/ with results/<task-id>/; files are UUID-named JSON. Move tasks atomically (rename between state dirs), never reshape or rename task_queue subfolders.
- Memory subsystem (see [memory/README.md](memory/README.md)): schema in [memory/models.py](memory/models.py#L1), vector search in [memory/vector_store.py](memory/vector_store.py#L1), manager API in [memory/manager.py](memory/manager.py#L1), embeddings via [memory/embed_repo.py](memory/embed_repo.py#L1) on GPU. PostgreSQL is the source of truth; vector backend swap is allowed.
- Containerization (see [docs/CONTAINERIZATION_STRATEGY.md](docs/CONTAINERIZATION_STRATEGY.md)): orchestrator expects TASK_QUEUE_PATH=/app/task_queue, POSTGRES_* envs, LLAMA_CPP_HOST=host.docker.internal, LLAMA_CPP_PORT=8080; volumes bind-mount task_queue and logs. Keep host CLIs out of containers unless strategy changes.
- Build/start discipline: Preferred entrypoints [build_all.sh](build_all.sh) or [start.sh](start.sh) (build --pull + up, start lms_bridge when present); rebuild via [rebuild.sh](rebuild.sh) (stop then start); stop via [stop.sh](stop.sh); inspect via [info.sh](info.sh). If you change docker-compose services/flags, mirror updates in these scripts.
- Health/logs: Orchestrator API at http://localhost:8000 (health at /health). Logs via `docker compose logs -f orchestrator`; status via `docker compose ps`.
- kmtui + host CLIs: Installed from scripts repo; kmtui writes queued tasks to host [task_queue/queued](task_queue/queued/). Preserve KM_* envs noted in [README.md](README.md#L1) when touching flows.
- Web viewer (koweb): Code in [orchestrator_web_viewer](orchestrator_web_viewer/README.md); run via `pip install -e modules/orchestrator_web_viewer/[termdash]` and `koweb -p 3001` (KO_WEB_* envs preferred). WebSocket manager at [orchestrator_web_viewer/websocket/manager.py](orchestrator_web_viewer/websocket/manager.py#L1); APIs under [orchestrator_web_viewer/api](orchestrator_web_viewer/api/).
- Visual QA: Use [skills/web-ui-visual-debug/web-ui-visual-debug.md](skills/web-ui-visual-debug/web-ui-visual-debug.md) to bring up koweb (docker compose up -d koweb or koweb CLI), open http://localhost:3001, and capture screenshots; reference persona [.github/agents/web-ui-visual.agent.md](.github/agents/web-ui-visual.agent.md) if needed.
- Testing discipline: Follow [.github/instructions/testing.instructions.md](.github/instructions/testing.instructions.md); run `pytest -q` where applicable. Web viewer tests live at [orchestrator_web_viewer/tests](orchestrator_web_viewer/tests/). Orchestrator has sparse coverage—validate via docker compose flows when code changes.
- Task queue + API changes: Keep JSON shapes aligned with [docs/TASK_QUEUE_DESIGN.md](docs/TASK_QUEUE_DESIGN.md); mirror REST style used in [docker/orchestrator/main.py](docker/orchestrator/main.py#L1) when adding endpoints.
- Logging/results: Orchestrator logs bind-mount to [logs](logs/); task outputs and artifacts must land under [task_queue/results](task_queue/results/). Do not relocate these directories.
- Safety/compliance: Never commit secrets or docker/.env; avoid deleting/renaming task_queue structure; document host-only assumptions (GPU, CLI tools) instead of baking them into images.
